pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ vassikasāṭikā anuññātā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū paṭikacceva vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesissanti paṭikacceva katvā nivāsessanti jiṇṇāya vassikasāṭikāya naggā kāyaṃ ovassāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.9: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave paṭikacceva vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.15: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā paṭikacceva vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesissatha paṭikacceva katvā nivāsessatha jiṇṇāya vassikasāṭikāya naggā kāyaṃ ovassāpessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.16: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāyapasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.17: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.18.1: māso seso gimhānanti bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ aḍḍhamāso seso gimhānanti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:1.19: orena ce māso seso gimhānanti vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyeseyya orenaḍḍhamāso seso gimhānanti katvā nivāseyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.1: māso seso gimhānanti bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.2: ye manussā pubbepi vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ denti te upasaṅkamitvā evamassu vacanīyā kālo vassikasāṭikāya samayo vassikasāṭikāya aññepi manussā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ dentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.3: na vattabbā detha me vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ āharatha me vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetha me vasasikasāṭikacīvaraṃ cetāpetha me vassikasāṭikacīvaranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.7: atirekamāse sese gimhāne vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesati nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.9: atirekaḍḍhamāse sese gimhāne katvā nivāseti nissaggiyaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.10: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.13: idaṃ me bhante vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ atirekamāse sese gimhāne pariyiṭṭhaṃ atirekaḍḍhamāse sese gimhāne katvā nivatthaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.18.1: atirekamāse sese gimhāne atirekasaññī vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesati nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.19: atirekamāse sese gimhāne vematiko vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesati nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.20: atirekamāse sese gimhāne ūnakasaññī vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesati nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.21: atirekaḍḍhamāse sese gimhāne atirekasaññī katvā nivāseti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.22: atirekaḍḍhamāse sese gimhāne vematiko katvā nivāseti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.23: atirekaḍḍhamāse sese gimhāne ūnakasaññī katvā nivāseti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.24: satiyā vassikasāṭikāya naggo kāyaṃ ovassāpeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.25: ūnakamāse sese gimhāne atirekasaññī āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.26: ūnakamāse sese gimhāne vematiko āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.28: ūnakaḍḍhamāse sese gimhāne atirekasaññī āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.29: ūnakaḍḍhamāse sese gimhāne vematiko āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np24:2.37: nivatthāya vassikasāṭikāya vassaṃ ukkaḍḍhiyati dhovitvā nikkhipitabbaṃ samaye nivāsetabbaṃ
